$comment: Every key is optional; an omitted key takes its default. Keys starting with
$ are ignored by the loader and exist only as notes.
There are no provider presets. Give the whole request URL in 'endpoint'.
Known values (see README for the table):
'apiKey' accepts a literal, or ${NAME} to read an environment variable.
Braces are required; a bare $NAME is sent literally, exactly as written.
The categories the model chooses between are NOT in this file. They live in
policy.json next to it, created from the built-in set on first run.
